sections.heading: Elon Musk — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Elon Musk was born on 28 June 1971 in Pretoria, and holds South African, Canadian and American nationality. He was given the name Elon Reeve Musk at birth and is publicly known as Elon Musk.
Public records name his father, Errol Musk and his mother, Maye Musk. He is a sibling of Tosca Musk, Kimbal Musk, Elliot Rush Musk, Asha Rose Musk and Alexandra Musk.
He studied at Smith School of Business, The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania and Pretoria Boys High School.
He is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Elon Musk — Career and Professional Work
paras: Elon Musk works primarily as a programmer, engineer, entrepreneur, investor, politician and civil servant, with PayPal, SpaceX and Tesla listed among his employers.

He has held the following offices: chief executive officer (2002–present), chairperson (2008–2018), chief executive officer (2008–present), co-president (2016–present), chief executive officer (2022–2023) and Senior Advisor to the President of the United States (2025–2025). He is affiliated with America Party.
He has taken part in B20 Bali 2022 and Ice Bucket Challenge.

sections.heading: Elon Musk — Net Worth: What Is Actually Verifiable
paras: Net-worth figures for Elon Musk circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.

What can be said from the public record is where his income is likely to originate: professional work as a programmer, engineer, entrepreneur, investor, politician and civil servant, employment with PayPal, SpaceX and Tesla and public office remuneration.
